small_guidance: The correctness failure with avg diff ~0.035 suggests numerical drift, likely from the tanh approximation in fused GELU and/or LayerNorm precision. Try: (1) compute LayerNorm mean/var using Welford or use tl.rsqrt and ensure float32 accumulation throughout — also verify weight/bias are loaded with the correct mask. (2) In the fused GELU path inside addmm, the tanh approximation clamping at ±88 is fine but verify the constants match HF's NewGELUActivation exactly (0.7978845608028654 * (x + 0.044715 * x^3)); ensure acc stays fp32 before applying. (3) Disable fuse_mlp_gelu first to isolate whether the mismatch comes from the fused GELU path or from addmm/LayerNorm itself.
large_guidance: If tuning doesn't fix correctness, redesign by: (1) keeping the matmul kernel standalone (no GELU fusion) and using a separate, well-tested GELU kernel — fused epilogue inside an autotuned GEMM is a common source of subtle bugs when accumulator dtype or bias broadcasting is off. (2) For LayerNorm, switch to a two-pass kernel that loads x once into registers and uses tl.sum with explicit fp32 cast, or use the canonical Triton LN tutorial structure to guarantee numerics. (3) Consider replacing Conv1D with torch.addmm via a thin wrapper first to verify the rest of the pipeline is bit-accurate, then reintroduce the Triton GEMM once isolated.
